interpretation: Minimal locally encoded request constraints from primary sources and existing working seller requests. Full OpenAPI was unavailable at initial preparation; the complete official schema was subsequently downloaded and confirms the existing /v1/actions/products/update request. This file remains a restricted evidence bundle, not the complete OpenAPI document. Mutations remain one-shot and require actual per-SKU readback; unresolved operations are not resent and unknown future enrollment is not sent.

evidence.basis: Official price request example contains prices array with offer_id, product_id, price, min_price, old_price and currency_code.
Official minimum-price setting and separate timer lifecycle; absent protection flag leaves that setting unchanged.
Existing working project request envelope; parent confirmed prior successful use.

/v1/product/import/prices.protection_order: timer update and active-expiry readback before price request

evidence.basis: Exact official request requires action_id and products with product_id and Money action_price. The existing one-product RUB payload conforms. stock is optional and must not be sent for elastic or maximum boosting. Rejected and Warning response items each document only integer uint64 product_id and string reason; rejection and removal-warning reasons remain separate.
Official update endpoint replaces activate; action_id, list of products and Money action_price; price affects unified seller cap.
Published request schema paths show the predecessor products[]/product_id structure; new announcement does not state a rename of these fields.
Current seller API v2 Money observations contain amount string and RUB currency.

/v1/actions/products/update.qualification: The initial composite evidence was used before the full official OpenAPI was available. The existing minimal request is now confirmed against that exact official schema; local one-product and RUB restrictions are unchanged. Retain only bounded, control-character-free product_id/reason details from rejected and warnings; all other raw response context remains excluded. This does not recover historical rejection reasons or authorize retries. Mutations remain one-shot; pending-operation reconciliation and actual per-SKU readback remain required. Do not guess alternate payload after rejection; response array naming alone is not success.

evidence.basis: Ozon moderator explicitly supplies root object with product_ids array of string int64 values and acknowledges the old documentation example error.
Timer update extends consideration of the minimum price; status endpoint reports expiration.

/v1/product/action/timer/update.response_policy: Confirm enabled=true, active=true, timestamp at least 29 days ahead. If disabled is not activated by renewal, hold SKU before changing its price.

future_enrollment.reason: Endpoint and scheduling semantics are documented; exact wire schema not established sufficiently. The current executor never sends this endpoint.
